siteSource: shared/sites.ts, from NASA Lunar Surface Data Book (M2M-30044) table A2.1-1. Center of an original candidate-region polygon; not an approved landing site.

raster.product: NASA GSFC PGDA product 78, adjusted local LOLA 5 m/pixel elevation (DM2 = Nobile rim 2)
raster.frame: MOON_ME reference frame of ephemeris DE421 (stated by the provider README; not encoded in the GeoTIFF CRS)
raster.valueMeaning: Surface height Z in meters above a 1,737,400 m reference sphere; interpolation fills pixels without LOLA returns
raster.citation: Barker et al. (2021), Planetary and Space Science 203, 105119, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119

referencePoints.name: Southwest broad crest
referencePoints.source: Selected by visual inspection of numeric DM2 elevation and illustrative hillshade within the 10 km crop; descriptive label, not an IAU feature name. Crest approximately 400 m above the reference site.

checkPoints.name: Southeast descending slope
checkPoints.source: Off-grid coordinate selected for an independent surface check, no mission significance.
